Workflows when you need more control
readme.excerpt: AutoGPT — Your team of AI Experts Bring in specialists for content, sales, research, and recurring work. Brief them in plain English. Let Otto coordinate. Sign up for a trial · Watch the demo · Meet the Experts · Pricing · Self-host · Contribute One conversation. The right expertise. Tell Otto what's on your plate. It brings in the right Experts, hands over the work, and keeps you up to date. Talk to a specialist directly when you want to get into the details. Each Expert has a role you can shape with your instructions, context, skills, and connected apps. Start with a ready-made specialist or create your own. Meet your team Put them to work --- --- Otto · Head of AI Coordinate a job across specialists and bring their work back to you. Maria · SEO Content Manager Turn a target keyword into a content brief and article draft. Max · Account Executive Research prospects, draft outreach, and prepare the next conversation. Frankie · Executive Assistant Prepare meeting context, email drafts, and a digest for the day. Explore the Experts → See the team at work One launch brief to Otto.
